reason: I'd maybe download the free version, since honest ranges instead of a fake 28-day guess and the doctor PDF actually sound useful. But I don't pay for apps, and an AI write-up of my own notes isn't worth $5 a month when Apple Health and my Notes app cost nothing.
objection: Every tracker says it understands irregular cycles, and then its predictions are useless for me. I'd want to see the free version work for a few months before I believe it, and even then the paid part is stuff I can live without.
would_change_my_mind: If the free version actually got my cycles roughly right for a few months and the AI summary helped me get a doctor to take me seriously and order PCOS tests, I might pay for a year once, at a deal.
